question.prompt: There are 10 people in the Chinese language group and 9 in the mathematics group. 4 people participate in both groups. Counting each person only once, how many people are there in total? Calculate: \(10+9-4=?\)

solutions.explanation: The sum \(10+9\) counts the 4 people in both groups twice. Subtracting 4 removes their extra count, leaving each person in either group counted once: \(10+9-4=15\). There are \(15\) people in total.
solutions.title: Remove the extra counts
